heading: Our Love Story
body: We met during Diwali celebrations 5 years ago. What started as a simple conversation turned into our forever. From late-night talks to planning our dreams together, every moment has been magical.

heading: Dress Code
body: Traditional Indian attire for ceremony. Festive ethnic wear for reception. Gold, maroon, and pastel shades preferred.

heading: Gift Preferences
body: Your blessings are the best gift. For those who insist, contribute to our honeymoon fund.

heading: Thank You!
body: We eagerly await your presence to make our day special. Your love and blessings mean the world to us.
